title: Theory that directed energy forces transdimensional objects into physical form

tellings.quote: by hitting it with like something like directed energy, you're forcing it to take form and become bound to this dimension.

plain: A man named Jordan, who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child, offers a theory about objects that move between dimensions. He says that hitting such an object with directed energy, meaning focused beams of energy used as a weapon, forces it to take solid form and become bound to our dimension. If true, it would explain how such objects could be caught or brought down.
